messages:
incident-bot: :loudspeaker: ALERT: sustained throughput degradation detected for hosted API in ap-southeast-1. Request throughput dropped ~40% and tail latency increased (p95 > 1.8s) starting 2026-04-02T03:12:00Z. Paging Nora (oncall). Alert id: thr-deg-ap-1915000000.

Nora (oncall): I'm on it. Quick triage: which endpoints are most impacted? @Harper any customer reports?

Harper (cs): a few customers on high-throughput plans reported slow generation and timeouts in the last 10 mins. No reports of lost data. I'll prepare a customer-facing blurb after we confirm mitigations.

Nora (oncall): initial telemetry: throughput drop concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat/completions for ap-southeast-1 region. Error distribution: increased 429s and some 504s at the gateway. No code deploys in the last hour per deploy-bot.

Ethan (SRE): looking at autoscaler and kube metrics. Noticing many containers entering CrashLoopBackOff tied to oom-kill on model-workers. Kernel OOM logs show bursts of memory pressure coinciding with heavy bursts. PVs look fine. Paste relevant snippet: ```Apr 02 03:14:07 kernel: Out of memory: kill process 23456 (model-worker) score 987 or sacrifice child
Apr 02 03:14:08 kubelet: oomkilled container model-worker in pod model-pool-5d9c
Apr 02 03:15:02 autoscaler: desired=12 current=4 failedAttempts=2```

Rina (platform): memory surge also correlates with a spike in client-side concurrency for a small group of API keys. Looks like some customers sent large-batch requests and our per-connection guardrails didn't cap memory per request.

Nora (oncall): mitigation plan (fast): 1) enable per-key rate limiting to throttle abusive bursts, 2) temporarily route heavy routes to dedicated fallback pool with larger instance sizes, 3) increase pod memory request for model-worker pool to reduce OOMs while we roll a safer config. Implementing step 1 now.

Nora (oncall): command: ```ratectl set-rate-limit --region ap-southeast-1 --mode per-api-key --max-reqs-per-min 1200``` 

ops-bot: ops-bot: rate limit configuration applied in region ap-southeast-1. Change id: rl-1915-001.

Rina (platform): routing to fallback pool: ```rbctl route adjust --from pool:hosted-ap-gen --to pool:hosted-ap-large --selectors '/v1/generate','/v1/chat/completions' --percent 35``` Executing now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing job queued: job-8054. No code deploys.

Ethan (SRE): increasing model-worker memory request on pool 'hosted-ap-gen' to avoid immediate OOMs: ```kube patch ds model-worker -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"model-worker","resources":{"requests":{"memory":"12Gi"}}}]}}}}'``` Rolling update in progress.

monitoring-bot: monitoring-bot: p95 before mitigations 1.86s, after rate limit + routing p95 1.25s within 6m. 429s increased temporarily as expected; 504s down 60%.

Harper (cs): Proposed customer update: 
"We experienced increased latency and throttling for the hosted generation endpoints in AP-SOUTHEAST-1 starting around 03:12 UTC. We applied rate limits to prevent bursty traffic from overwhelming our model pool, rerouted some traffic to higher-capacity instances, and are rolling a configuration to reduce OOMs. If you hit 429s, please retry with exponential backoff; this is temporary while we stabilize."

Nora (oncall): posting a quick statuspage draft. statuspage-bot, please prepare a public message that we can send after 15m monitoring.

statuspage-bot: statuspage-bot: Draft created for status.redwood.ai: "Investigating reduced throughput and elevated latency in AP-SOUTHEAST-1 affecting text generation endpoints. Mitigations in progress: rate limiting, traffic reroute to larger instances, and worker memory tuning. No known data loss. Updates to follow." Preview: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1915000000

Ethan (SRE): rolling update completed on 6 of 8 nodes. Some pods still restarting but OOM events dropped significantly. Memory usage steady now.

Nora (oncall): current status: mitigations active, p95 ~1.1s on routed traffic, overall region p95 1.3s. Error spikes from clients reduced. Moving to MONITORING.

Rina (platform): follow-up items: 1) add per-request memory accounting and limits in the gateway to clamp large batches, 2) add a proactive safeguard to move oversized API keys to a dedicated pool or apply strict concurrency caps, 3) add clearer responses for 429 to include retry-after header.

Ethan (SRE): created ticket INFRA-4702 (per-request-memory-guards) with logs and sample traces.

Harper (cs): I'll send targeted notices to customers who hit the throttles, include the retry guidance and link to the status page.

Nora (oncall): handoff notes for next on-call (Ethan): 
- What I did: applied per-key rate limits, routed 35% traffic to hosted-ap-large, increased worker memory requests, monitored p95 improvements.
- What to watch: p95, 429 counts, pod restarts, any customers reporting persistent failures.
- Tickets: INFRA-4702, status.redwood.ai/incidents/1915000000

Ethan (SRE): taking monitoring. I'll also coordinate with Rina to add the gateway memory clamping to next sprint.

Nora (oncall): statuspage-bot, please post initial public update that we have applied mitigations and are monitoring.

statuspage-bot: statuspage-bot: Public update posted: "Mitigations in place for throughput degradation in AP-SOUTHEAST-1. We applied rate limits and routed traffic to larger instances; monitoring for full recovery. If you experience throttling, retry with backoff." https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1915000000/updates/1

Harper (cs): customer emails sent to impacted accounts. Included recommended retry pattern and expected monitor window of 60 minutes.

Rina (platform): scheduling follow-up INFRA-4703 to introduce a 'burst-protection' filter at the gateway and update developer docs on acceptable batch sizes to avoid memory exhaustion.

Ethan (SRE): p95 stabilized at ~0.98s for routed traffic, region-wide p95 1.05s. Will monitor for 1 hour before closing.

Nora (oncall): thanks team. Good work on rapid containment. I'll draft the incident timeline and include customer contact timestamps for the postmortem. Closing live paging; incident remains active for post-ops. :white_check_mark:
